data.body: Landed: Gerrit 3040, PS2 LLM-Review +1 and Verified +1, 0 unresolved; submitted at revision 0b4062cbbbac; merged on main as 864b6f56c91 (server rebase over 21dabcbb2c1). PS2 corrected the _plan_review_variant docstring (an unreadable fingerprint yields the literal `material=None` key) and added a variant-level test. make verify on the fix: 17 failed / 20352 passed, all 17 the known arm64 pandoc `Bad CPU type` host defect (frenzied-snively-llama), nothing else. First push attempt was rejected `remote unpack failed: Missing tree 96cc404c1cb` (tree of 08033c6ae93, an ancestor of HEAD already on Gerrit as refs/changes/42/2742/2); the identical push succeeded on retry, consistent with a transient server object-store fault. Advisory left as-is: current_material_fingerprint_impl re-raises only while a pinned completion view is bound, which the MCP tool entry points never bind.
